result.summary: The street is a two-lane thoroughfare with continuous sidewalks on both sides but lacks any marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming infrastructure. The long, straight roadway geometry and lack of buffers between the walkway and moving traffic create an environment that prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked crossing points for pedestrians along this long, straight stretch of road.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible throughout the length of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: A continuous line of parked vehicles on the right side can obscure pedestrians, especially children, from the view of approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the curb

hazards.name: High-speed road design
hazards.description: The wide, straight lanes and lack of traffic calming measures encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential and commercial context.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to provide safe, designated crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb extensions (bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Speed humps or tables
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds along this straight corridor.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street lined with row houses and a continuous sidewalk. The pedestrian environment is functional but degraded, with significant cracking in the pavement and a lack of physical buffering from the roadway.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: Significant cracking, uneven slabs, and vegetation growth in the joints create tripping hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the foreground and middle ground of the sidewalk area.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the curb with no planting strip or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line throughout the visible block.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Leveling
interventions.description: Resurface or replace damaged concrete slabs to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Introduce street trees to provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while improving the microclimate.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

result.summary: The street features a wide roadway with a marked bike lane and parallel parking, which provides some buffer for pedestrians on the sidewalks. However, the lack of marked crossings and the significant crossing distance between intersections create a challenging environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway lacks a median or refuge island, requiring pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic at once.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can block the sight lines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at intersections or mid-block to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crossings with high-visibility patterns to alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image depicts a hostile pedestrian environment along a wide, multi-lane arterial road with no visible crossing infrastructure. A narrow sidewalk on the far side is obstructed by a vehicle parked across the walkway, and the streetscape is dominated by blank frontages and chain-link fencing from a car dealership.

hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway lacks any marked crossings or refuge islands, creating a high-risk environment for pedestrians attempting to cross.
